name: golfapi
description: Golf club specifications as each maker published them: drivers to putters, lofts, lies, hands, release years and launch prices.

interface.longDescription:
GolfAPI.dev is a read-only catalog of golf club specifications as each maker published them: lofts, lies, head volume, hands, adjustable hosels, release dates and US launch prices for 2.7k+ club models released 2000 to 2026, across drivers, mini-drivers, fairway woods, hybrids, irons, wedges and putters. A field the maker did not publish is left out rather than guessed.

Six tools: describe_api, search_clubs, get_club, get_coverage, get_changes and api_get. Every tool is a read. Each call is one request on your GolfAPI.dev plan.

Connecting asks for a GolfAPI.dev API key once. A free key reads a fixed sample of 20 drivers from 10 makers released in 2025, plus 2 mini-drivers and 2 fairway woods, specifications only. A Hobby key reads all seven club types. A Pro key adds US launch prices and allows commercial use.
